acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of garbage disposal installation in the Las Vegas area can vary depending on several factors, including the type of disposal unit, whether it's a new installation or a replacement, and any necessary plumbing or electrical modifications. While we can't provide exact prices without an assessment, new installations often involve more labor. We recommend contacting CG Plumbing Solutions for a personalized quote tailored to your specific needs and the complexity of the job in your North Las Vegas, Henderson, or Summerlin home.
